runs.title: Keanu's Netflix Maelstrom: what is it?
runs.prompt: Today (27 October 2026) news broke that Keanu Reeves is replacing Alan Ritchson in a Netflix film called 'Maelstrom.' Using only plain page fetches (no search, no logins), find out: (1) what the film is about, (2) when it's expected to hit Netflix, and (3) what has been reported about why Alan Ritchson dropped out. Report the facts and name the source of each.
runs.answer: MovieWeb (Marcos Melendez, published Oct 26, 2026, "Keanu Reeves Officially Replaces Alan Ritchson in New 'Die Hard'-Esque Netflix Action Thriller") reports: (1) Maelstrom is a single-location thriller, directed by Jaume Collet-Serra (Carry-On), about a Federal Marshal who must fend off an arms dealer's goons when a hurricane traps him with the fiancée of the criminal, who is seeking witness protection; the spec script was bought by Warner Bros. in 1993 (original draft by the late Gregory Fitzpatrick, now rewritten by Mark Bianculli, with Jeff Robinov producing). (2) No Netflix date exists yet — MovieWeb says only that "it's unclear when Maelstrom will get off the ground and get cameras rolling," i.e. no release window announced. (3) On the exit, MovieWeb states plainly that "the reason for the Reacher star's departure has not been revealed," while noting Variety confirmed the Reeves casting after PageSix reported it first. CBR (Jamie Lovett, "Keanu Reeves Replaces Alan Ritchson in Netflix Action Thriller Called Die Hard in a Hurricane") corroborates the casting swap but gives no plot, date or departure reason in the retrieved result.

runs.title: Elizabeth NJ vigil shooting: the official word
runs.prompt: Overnight into 27 October 2026, gunfire at a vigil on Irvington Avenue in Elizabeth, New Jersey, reportedly left one person dead and several hurt. Using only plain page fetches (no search, no logins), find factual reporting on what happened and what local police or officials have said, including the number of injured and any official statement or update channel for residents. Keep it factual and respectful.
runs.answer: Gunfire broke out at a candlelight vigil near Irvington Avenue and Oakwood Place in Elizabeth around 9:30–10 p.m. Monday, 26 October 2026: five people were shot, one was pronounced dead at the scene and four others were wounded and hospitalized (ABC7 says three were taken to University Hospital in Newark — one shot in the chest, two in the arms/legs; NBC says all four were taken to a hospital). Witnesses described a barrage of shots and dozens of shell casings over several blocks; officials said a red sedan fled westbound on Morris Avenue and a burning red sedan was found about an hour later on Hobson Street in Newark, being checked for a link. The Union County Prosecutor's Office is leading the investigation and Elizabeth Police referred all inquiries there; two people of interest have been identified but no arrests made, and the deceased's identity has not been released. Anyone with information should call Elizabeth police or the prosecutor's office, or submit anonymous tips at 908-654-TIPS (8477) or uctip.org — note that the prosecutor's website (ucpo.org) was returning a server error when checked, so residents should watch UCPO statements and local news for updates.
